ticker_news.title: Nasdaq Correction: 5 Reasons Nvidia Stock Is Still a Top Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock to Buy Right Now
ticker_news.description: Despite the recent sell-off in AI stocks, including Nvidia, the article argues that Nvidia is still a top AI stock to buy due to the continued growth in AI adoption, Nvidia's technological advancements, and its attractive valuation.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: Wall Street Rockets As February Inflation Cools More Than Expected
ticker_news.description: Major U.S. indices surged as cooling inflation strengthened the case for Fed rate cuts. Tech stocks like Tesla, Palantir, and NVIDIA led the premarket gains.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari

SPY.title: Inflation Cools More Than Expected In February, Strengthens The Case For Fed Rate Cuts
SPY.description: Inflation eased in February, coming in lower than expected and reinforcing the Federal Reserve's path toward interest rate cuts. The headline Consumer Price Index fell to 2.8% year-over-year, and core inflation slowed to 3.1%, strengthening the case for Fed rate cuts in 2025.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari

QQQ.title: Nasdaq Sell-Off: Don't Panic; Use This Strategy Instead
QQQ.description: The article discusses the recent Nasdaq correction and suggests using a dollar-cost averaging strategy to invest in the Invesco Nasdaq 100 ETF (QQQ) as a way to take advantage of the market downturn.
QQQ.author: The Motley Fool
